positions.name: SlugGenerationOnMissingId
positions.frame: what must the pipeline do when a memory is submitted without an explicit id?
positions.why: src-1 establishes the triggering condition — no explicit id was supplied on submission — and src-2 prescribes the pipeline's required response to that condition: derive a slug (via LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback) and commit successfully. Read together, one names the gap and the other names the mandated fill; neither alone carries the directional sense of condition-and-requirement that the pair does.
